:Hi :) [[Jorin din Jubai White Wing|Jorin]] is a [[Windfinder]], not a [[Wavemistress]].{{ref/book|4|19}} A Wavemistress is ruler of the clan and ranks highest, followed by Sailmistress who is captain of the ship, followed by Windfinder.
